title: If You Have Multiple Interests, Please Start a One-Person Business

sentences.en: This quote has been living in my head rent free for the past year.
sentences.zh: 这句话在过去一年里一直在我脑子里挥之不去。

sentences.en: Now, a few years ago, when I first started creating content online because I wanted to get out of doing cold outreach to land freelance clients, I started to notice people, specifically creators who were building 1 to $10 million, one person businesses, and they weren't working all day.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我刚开始在网上创作内容，因为我不想再做冷外联去接自由职业的单子了。那时候我开始注意到一些人，特别是那些正在打造100万到1000万美元一人企业的创作者，而且他们并不是整天都在工作。

sentences.en: I think Justin Welsh is a perfect example of this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得Justin Welsh就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: He highly values his time and he only works for a little bit in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他非常看重自己的时间，每天只在早上工作一小会儿。

sentences.en: But he has the pieces of a business that we're going to talk about that allow him to make that much money.
sentences.zh: 但他拥有一个生意所需的各个组件——我们接下来会聊到——正是这些让他能赚到那么多钱。

sentences.en: This is actually possible now, thanks to the internet, social media and AI, people still don't realize how much leverage and power they have as an individual.
sentences.zh: 这在现在是完全可能的，多亏了互联网、社交媒体和AI，人们还没意识到作为个体，他们手里握着多大的杠杆和力量。

sentences.en: We are completely beyond the getting paid for your time model.
sentences.zh: 我们已经彻底超越了按时间计酬的模式。

sentences.en: We are completely in the get paid for your mind and value model, which is completely detached from time.
sentences.zh: 我们完全进入了按头脑和价值计酬的模式，这个模式完全脱离了时间。

sentences.en: And for a lot of people that doesn't click.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，这个概念转不过弯来。

sentences.en: But the best way I can explain it is you can write one piece of content, and if that content gets a million views and you get 1% of those people to buy a $100 product, I will let you do the math.
sentences.zh: 但我能给出的最好解释是：你可以写一篇内容，如果这篇内容获得一百万次观看，而你能让其中1%的人买一个100美元的产品，账你自己算吧。

sentences.en: Now, of course, you probably aren't going to get a million views on your first piece of content, but I think you get the point.
sentences.zh: 当然，你的第一篇内容可能不会有一百万次观看，但我想你明白我的意思了。

sentences.en: It is something that you practice.
sentences.zh: 这是需要练习的东西。

sentences.en: It is a skill that you can develop, and it is one of the highest value skills that companies, creators, everyone is hiring for right now.
sentences.zh: 这是一项你可以培养的技能，而且是目前公司、创作者、所有人都在争相雇佣的最高价值技能之一。

sentences.en: That's why this video may be very important to you.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这个视频对你来说可能非常重要。

sentences.en: So these creators that I noticed who were building 1 to $10 million, one person businesses, what they were doing was selling either an education or info product or coaching, or a mix of both with social media as their way of distribution.
sentences.zh: 我注意到的那些打造100万到1000万美元一人企业的创作者，他们做的事是销售教育或信息产品，或者教练服务，或者两者结合，用社交媒体作为分发渠道。

sentences.en: Not paid ads, not sponsoring podcasts, not billboards, not the radio, not TV, social media.
sentences.zh: 不是付费广告，不是赞助播客，不是广告牌，不是广播，不是电视，是社交媒体。

sentences.en: Because that's where the attention is.
sentences.zh: 因为注意力在那里。

sentences.en: Building an audience is free. Creating information is free.
sentences.zh: 建立受众是免费的。创造信息是免费的。

sentences.en: This is the low risk business model for the beginner, because with things like e-commerce, you have to invest capital in the product.
sentences.zh: 对新手来说，这是低风险的商业模式，因为像电商这类事情，你得在产品上投入资金。

sentences.en: There is no start up costs aside from the time invested in learning the skill to start a one person social media business in today's world.
sentences.zh: 在当今世界，启动一个一人社交媒体生意，除了投入时间学习技能之外，没有任何启动成本。

sentences.en: But from then a few years ago and then building those businesses to now, things are much different.
sentences.zh: 但从几年前开始打造那些生意到现在，情况已经大不相同了。

sentences.en: Back then, you could build a 1 to $10 million, one person business, and the average person was completely oblivious to that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 那时候，你可以打造一个100万到1000万美元的一人企业，而普通人完全没意识到那个机会。

sentences.en: And so they're even more oblivious to this new opportunity thanks to AI.
sentences.zh: 而现在，多亏了AI，他们对这个新机会更加浑然不觉。

sentences.en: And now GPT six, Astra and Fable 5.1 and whatever the next model is going to be, just make it even more possible.
sentences.zh: 现在的GPT-6、Astra和Fable 5.1，还有下一个不知道什么模型，只是让这件事变得更可行了。

sentences.en: And your competitive advantage here is that the average person is just completely oblivious.
sentences.zh: 而你的竞争优势就在于，普通人完全没意识到。

sentences.en: They don't do anything and they're not going to change their habits.
sentences.zh: 他们什么都不做，也不会改变自己的习惯。

sentences.en: But the beautiful, very beautiful thing about this is that you don't need to make $1 million.
sentences.zh: 但这件事最美妙、非常美妙的地方在于，你不需要赚100万美元。

sentences.en: You don't need to make $10 million.
sentences.zh: 你不需要赚1000万美元。

sentences.en: Most people watching this just want to replace their current income sources.
sentences.zh: 大多数看这个视频的人，只是想替换掉当前的收入来源。

sentences.en: That could be $75,000 a year, $100,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 那可能是每年7.5万美元，每年10万美元。

sentences.en: And what I'm telling you is that that is incredibly achievable.
sentences.zh: 而我要告诉你的是，这完全是可以实现的。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that it's easy or is going to happen quick.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着它很容易，或者会很快发生。

sentences.en: I'm just saying that it is very for myself.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，这对我来说是非常可行的。

sentences.en: When I first started out, my goal was to be able to afford Chipotle for lunch every day, and I'm proud to say that I achieved that pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始的时候，我的目标是每天午餐能吃得起Chipotle，我很自豪地说，我很快就实现了这个目标。

sentences.en: And I don't eat Chipotle for lunch every day now, even though I'm probably going to have it today.
sentences.zh: 我现在也不是天天吃 Chipotle 当午饭了，虽然今天可能还是会吃。

sentences.en: But ever since I was a kid, I just didn't want to go down the default path.
sentences.zh: 但从小时候起，我就是不想走那条默认的路。

sentences.en: I was very observant as a kid to those around me, and it just didn't make sense to go to school and get an education and pay a ton of money to get an education.
sentences.zh: 我小时候很会观察身边的人，去上学、拿个学位、花一大笔钱去拿个学位，这件事本身就说不通。

sentences.en: That would be completely irrelevant in ten years.
sentences.zh: 十年后这些东西会变得毫无意义。

sentences.en: And then getting a job that you're dependent on and takes up all of your time.
sentences.zh: 然后找一份你完全依赖、还占掉你所有时间的工作。

sentences.en: So you can't self educate on the side and shift direction, and then marrying someone that you despise, and then being promised retirement, but never really being able to stop working.
sentences.zh: 这样你就没法在业余时间自学、没法转换方向，接着跟一个你受不了的人结婚，然后被承诺退休，却永远没法真正停止工作。

sentences.en: That was all normal and it disgusted me.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是"正常"的，而它让我感到恶心。

sentences.en: So from that, I came to the realization that entrepreneurship was the only path out.
sentences.zh: 从那之后我意识到，创业是唯一的出路。

sentences.en: That was the path for me, whether I liked it or not, because it was this big, mysterious thing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那就是我的路，不管我愿不愿意，因为它是一个巨大而神秘的东西。

sentences.en: Starting a business was something that I wasn't capable of doing at the time.
sentences.zh: 创业这件事，当时的我根本做不到。

sentences.en: And so that's what I did. I failed over and over again.
sentences.zh: 所以我就去做了。我一次又一次地失败。

sentences.en: I started a fitness YouTube channel.
sentences.zh: 我开了一个健身 YouTube 频道。

sentences.en: I tried dropshipping minimalist wallets.
sentences.zh: 我试过做极简钱包的 dropshipping。

sentences.en: I tried selling blue light glasses, I did freelance SEO and Facebook ads and web design until I finally had to get a job because the student and credit card debt was just piling up.
sentences.zh: 我试过卖蓝光眼镜，做过自由职业的 SEO、Facebook 广告和网页设计，直到最后不得不去找一份工作，因为学生贷款和信用卡债务越堆越高。

sentences.en: And when I did get that job, I saw the job as a deadline.
sentences.zh: 当我真的去上班的时候，我把那份工作看成一个倒计时。

sentences.en: I knew that if I didn't make my own thing, work soon, that I would start drowning in bills and responsibilities and I wouldn't be able to get out.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果我不尽快把自己的东西做起来，就会被账单和责任淹没，再也出不来了。

sentences.en: So about seven years ago, I was able to quit my full time job to do freelance web design, because that was one of the skills that I had.
sentences.zh: 所以大概七年前，我辞掉了全职工作去做自由职业网页设计，因为那是我当时拥有的技能之一。

sentences.en: About six years ago, I started on social media and made around $10,000 with digital products.
sentences.zh: 大概六年前，我开始做社交媒体，靠数字产品赚了大概一万美元。

sentences.en: The next year it was $100,000, then $800,000.
sentences.zh: 第二年赚了十万美元，然后是八十万美元。

sentences.en: And I have a video on how I did that while writing two hours a day.
sentences.zh: 我有一期视频专门讲我是怎么做到每天只写两小时就达到这个结果的。

sentences.en: Then the next year was around $4 million and my tax bill had officially quadrupled to what my old salary was.
sentences.zh: 再下一年大概是四百万美元，我的税单正式变成了我原来工资的四倍。

sentences.en: And then as I made the stupid, hopefully long term decision to get into software, my income started to stabilize around 1 to 1.5 million a year because I had to shift time and focus to software and shovel a ton of money into it.
sentences.zh: 然后我做了那个愚蠢的、希望是长期正确的决定——进入软件领域，收入开始稳定在每年一百到一百五十万美元左右，因为我必须把时间和精力转移到软件上，还要往里面砸一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Because we're bootstrapped, and I still have not paid myself a penny from cortex or the new what it is Eden.
sentences.zh: 因为我们是自筹资金，而且我到现在还没从 Cortex 或者现在叫 Eden 的东西里给自己发过一分钱。

sentences.en: But we're getting there.
sentences.zh: 但我们快到了。

sentences.en: Eden is very quickly picking up steam, and you guys are not going to believe the next update.
sentences.zh: Eden 的增长势头非常快，你们绝对不会相信下一次更新会是什么样。

sentences.en: So what I'm saying is, I have a lot to share on the one person business thing, and I can see it from the top down because my audience and my customers are quite literally one person businesses, and I can see what's working, what's not working.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，关于一人企业这件事，我有很多可以分享的，而且我能从上往下看，因为我的受众和客户几乎都是一人企业，我能看到什么在奏效、什么不行。

sentences.en: And when it comes to AI, I kind of have front row seats as to how that can help you build this thing faster.
sentences.zh: 而当谈到 AI 的时候，我基本上坐在前排，能看到它怎么帮你更快地把这件事做起来。

sentences.en: So let's actually get started and begin.
sentences.zh: 那我们就正式开始吧。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about why your interests or unique value plus social media or free distribution plus AI or cheap force multiplication equals a profitable one person or one human business.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊的是，为什么你的兴趣或者说你的独特价值，加上社交媒体或者说免费分发，再加上 AI 或者说廉价的杠杆放大，就等于一个能盈利的一人企业。

sentences.en: Now, as a one person business, you're going to post on social media.
sentences.zh: 作为一人企业，你要在社交媒体上发内容。

sentences.en: Bu I know it's so hard to write for 30 minutes in the morning and then post it where everyone else in the world has the potential of seeing it.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，早上花三十分钟写点东西，然后发到一个全世界所有人都可能看到的地方，这件事真的很难。

sentences.en: But as I said, social media is where the attention is right now and you probably don't have the capital to invest in paid ads or paying creators $2,500 to post one real about your product.
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，社交媒体是当下注意力所在的地方，而你很可能没有资金去投付费广告，或者花两千五百美元请一个创作者为你的产品发一条 Reel。

sentences.en: The price is for this.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在的行情。

sentences.en: UGC stuff is just getting insane.
sentences.zh: UGC 这块的价格已经疯掉了。

sentences.en: I personally think it's better to just hire in-house or build your own audience as the founder.
sentences.zh: 我个人觉得，不如直接招内部团队，或者作为创始人，自己把受众做起来。

sentences.en: Now in this video, I'm also assuming that you don't care to start a service business or a client business like freelancing or agency work because you want some form of freedom and a creative lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 另外，这期视频我默认你不想做服务型生意，也不想做客户型生意，比如接单或开工作室，因为你想要某种自由，想要一种创造性的生活方式。

sentences.en: Now, some of what we're going to talk about will apply to you if you have that style of business, because you should probably build an audience either way.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你已经在做这类生意，我们接下来聊的很多东西也适用，因为不管怎样，你都应该把受众做起来。

sentences.en: But I personally prefer writing and building products that sell while I sleep.
sentences.zh: 但我个人更喜欢写作，喜欢做那种我睡觉时也能卖的产品。

sentences.en: Now we're going to talk about what this one person business looks like.
sentences.zh: 好，我们先聊聊这个一人企业长什么样。

sentences.en: What is it composed of, and what are the pieces that you need?
sentences.zh: 它由什么构成，你需要哪些拼图？

sentences.en: And then I'm going to give you little AI employees that you can just start using.
sentences.zh: 然后我会给你几个小小的 AI 员工，你可以直接开始用。

sentences.en: The link to them is in the description.
sentences.zh: 链接在视频描述里。

sentences.en: You can just start chatting, and you will essentially be able to run your business from those six employees that I give you.
sentences.zh: 你直接开始聊就行，基本上靠我给你的这六个员工，你就能运转你的生意。

sentences.en: You can do it in Eden with one click and they're all in one place.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Eden 里一键搞定，它们全都在一个地方。

sentences.en: Or you can download the individual skill file that you would upload to Claude, or you can add them to Eden and then connect it into the cloud via the MCP, so that Claude is able to see trending social media posts and do research.
sentences.zh: 或者你也可以下载单独的技能文件，上传到 Claude，或者把它们加到 Eden，然后通过 MCP 接入云端，这样 Claude 就能看到热门社交媒体帖子，还能做调研。

sentences.en: And it can access these customize or these employees.
sentences.zh: 它也能调用这些定制好的东西，也就是这些员工。

sentences.en: So the first thing we need to nail down when it comes to building a one person business is just brand, which is how you present yourself or your business to the world.
sentences.zh: 好，做一人企业，第一件要敲定的事就是品牌，也就是你如何向世界呈现你自己，或者你的生意。

sentences.en: Now in your personal life, when people think of your name, what do they think of?
sentences.zh: 在你的个人生活里，别人想到你的名字，会想到什么？

sentences.en: What do they associate you with?
sentences.zh: 他们会把你跟什么联系在一起？

sentences.en: Are you cool to be around?
sentences.zh: 跟你待在一起舒服吗？

sentences.en: What are your likes and your dislikes?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢什么，不喜欢什么？

sentences.en: Are you fun to be around or are you funny or you helpful?
sentences.zh: 跟你待在一起好玩吗？你有趣吗？还是你很有帮助？

sentences.en: Are you trustworthy?
sentences.zh: 你值得信任吗？

sentences.en: Are you valuable?
sentences.zh: 你有价值吗？

sentences.en: What do people come to you for things like that?
sentences.zh: 别人会因为什么事情来找你？类似这些东西。

sentences.en: So brand is that, but for your business, it's like a digital storefront or a digital identity.
sentences.zh: 品牌就是这个，只不过用在你的生意上，它就像一个数字店面，或者说一个数字身份。

sentences.en: It's what makes people buy your app, or your course, or your coaching or your e-commerce product over someone else's, even if it's a worse product, because there are plenty of incredible, amazing apps, courses, etc. but you don't even hear about them because you don't even know they exist.
sentences.zh: 它能让人们买你的 App、你的课程、你的教练服务，或者你的电商产品，而不是买别人的，哪怕你的产品更差。因为市面上有太多好到不可思议的 App、课程等等，但你根本没听说过，因为你根本不知道它们存在。

sentences.en: And if you didn't know they exist, if a creator that you liked who had helped you before because you spent so much time with their content, offered a similar product, you would buy the creators product that you liked.
sentences.zh: 而如果你不知道它们存在，但有一个你喜欢的创作者，你花了很多时间看他的内容，他之前也帮到过你，如果他推出了类似的产品，你会买那个你喜欢的创作者的产品。

sentences.en: This is how marketers or people who study marketing, not digital marketing, but actual marketing, make ten x more than programmers who just build little portfolio apps and don't know how to sell them.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么懂营销的人，或者说真正研究过营销的人——不是数字营销，是真正的营销——比那些只会做几个作品集 App、不知道怎么卖的开发者，能多赚十倍。

sentences.en: Now, as a one person business, your brand is a personal brand, and even if you're not a one person business, look at Elon Musk, look at Mr. Beast. Look at most of the celebrities today.
sentences.zh: 好，作为一个一人企业，你的品牌就是个人品牌。就算你不是一人企业，看看 Elon Musk，看看 Mr. Beast，看看今天大多数名人。

sentences.en: They all are building a personal brand because that's what you do in today's world, a personal brand is one of the most effective business growth strategies because it's free to do.
sentences.zh: 他们全都在打造个人品牌，因为在今天这个世界，你就得这么做。个人品牌是最有效的业务增长策略之一，因为它是免费的。

sentences.en: And if done correctly, you barely have to actually market yourself.
sentences.zh: 而且如果做对了，你几乎不需要刻意去推销自己。

sentences.en: So it's your values, it's your worldview and your story externalized.
sentences.zh: 所以，它就是你的价值观、你的世界观和你的故事，向外呈现出来。

sentences.en: So one of the little AI employees that I give you below interviews you for information about yourself to extract all of these things into what is a comprehensive personal brand strategy document that you can then give to any other AI, like at any time when you're in any chat, you have this document that you can take with you anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我下面给你的其中一个 AI 小员工，会像采访一样问你关于你自己的信息，把所有这些提炼成一份全面的个人品牌策略文档。之后你随时可以把它交给任何其他 AI，不管你在哪个对话里，这份文档你都可以随身带着走。

sentences.en: This is necessary because it gives you your vision, your anti vision, your content pillars.
sentences.zh: 这很必要，因为它会给你你的愿景、你的反愿景、你的内容支柱。

sentences.en: So all of the content ideas that you're going to generate, if you want them to have a through line and impact, should at least start from this personal brand strategy document.
sentences.zh: 所以，你未来要生成的所有内容创意，如果你想让它们有一条贯穿的主线，有影响力，至少应该从这份个人品牌策略文档出发。

sentences.en: Now the second thing you need as a one person business is an offer, which is what people pay you for that helps them get a result.
sentences.zh: 好，做一人企业，你需要的第二样东西是 offer，也就是别人付钱给你、你帮他们拿到结果的那个东西。

sentences.en: So you need a product or service that's kind of obvious.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要一个产品或服务，这基本是明摆着的。

sentences.en: You can't make money without one and you can.
sentences.zh: 没有产品或服务你赚不到钱，有了你就能。

sentences.en: You can go the audience route and just build, build, build your audience and then take brand deals, which is a very profitable thing to do, but it just makes sense to have your own product or service these days.
sentences.zh: 你可以走受众路线，就是不断积累、积累、积累你的受众，然后接品牌合作，这很赚钱，但如今拥有自己的产品或服务才是更明智的选择。

sentences.en: Now, the difference between an offer and a product and service is that an offer is the perceived value of that product or service.
sentences.zh: 现在，要约和产品/服务的区别在于，要约是那个产品或服务的感知价值。

sentences.en: It's how you package it.
sentences.zh: 是你如何包装它。

sentences.en: It's the deal that you're making.
sentences.zh: 是你给出的那个交易条件。

sentences.en: This is one of the most profitable skills you can learn.
sentences.zh: 这是你能学到的最赚钱的技能之一。

sentences.en: Offer creation because once you nail the offer, the landing page, the copywriting, the marketing and the rest just becomes so much easier because it's already there and that's what you compete on.
sentences.zh: 要约设计，因为一旦你搞定了要约，着陆页、文案、营销和其他一切都会变得容易得多，因为它已经立在那里了，而这就是你竞争的核心。

sentences.en: You're not competing on the product or service level, you're competing on the offer level.
sentences.zh: 你不是在产品或服务层面竞争，你是在要约层面竞争。

sentences.en: So the amount of value compared to the price.
sentences.zh: 也就是价值与价格之比。

sentences.en: So if you were to take a second brain app or a research tool like the YouTube research tool that everyone uses, and then you look at Eden, which is able to research all platforms through the MCP, through the chat, and have all of your ideas, notes, links, posts and soon products in one place.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你拿一个第二大脑应用，或者一个研究工具，比如大家都在用的YouTube研究工具，然后你再看Eden，它能通过MCP、通过聊天研究所有平台，并且把你所有的想法、笔记、链接、帖子，很快还有产品，都集中在一个地方。

sentences.en: Eden is obviously the better deal, if you'll allow me to brag for a bit.
sentences.zh: Eden显然是更划算的选择，请允许我自夸一下。

sentences.en: And it has social scheduling, so it replaces another app to its the entire creator workflow.
sentences.zh: 而且它还有社交排期功能，所以它替代了另一个应用，覆盖了整个创作者工作流。

sentences.en: But offer creation is the art of pulling four levers.
sentences.zh: 但要约设计是拉动四个杠杆的艺术。

sentences.en: The first is the dream outcome.
sentences.zh: 第一个是梦想结果。

sentences.en: So what the customer actually wants to is the delivery mechanism.
sentences.zh: 也就是客户真正想要达成的目标。

sentences.en: So how you get them there? Is it a course?
sentences.zh: 第二个是交付机制。

sentences.en: Is it coaching?
sentences.zh: 你怎么带他们到达那里？是一个课程吗？

sentences.en: Is it a supplement?
sentences.zh: 是教练服务吗？

sentences.en: What is the unique mechanism for those things?
sentences.zh: 是一个补充剂吗？

sentences.en: What is your way of doing it?
sentences.zh: 这些东西的独特机制是什么？

sentences.en: Getting them the dream outcome three is the speed of results.
sentences.zh: 你实现它的方式是什么？

sentences.en: So how fast you get them there and four is the guarantee.
sentences.zh: 带他们达成梦想结果，第三个是结果的速度。

sentences.en: So what happens if it fails?
sentences.zh: 你多快能带他们到达，第四个是保障。

sentences.en: Those are the four things you need.
sentences.zh: 如果失败了怎么办？

sentences.en: Write those down.
sentences.zh: 这就是你需要的四样东西。

sentences.en: And again the AI will help you create your offer.
sentences.zh: 把它们写下来。

sentences.en: Now the third thing you need as a one person business is distribution.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，AI会帮你设计你的要约。

sentences.en: So how you spread your brand or offer.
sentences.zh: 现在，作为一人企业，你需要的第三样东西是分发。

sentences.en: And I love this quote from Jack butcher.
sentences.zh: 也就是你如何传播你的品牌或要约。

sentences.en: Build distribution, then build whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢Jack Butcher的一句话。

sentences.en: Because we're living in the internet age where attention equals leverage.
sentences.zh: 先建立分发，然后你想建什么就建什么。

sentences.en: You can have the best brand, you can have the best product, but none of that matters if nobody knows you exist.
sentences.zh: 因为我们生活在互联网时代，注意力等于杠杆。

sentences.en: So distribution for what we're concerned with is everything from marketing to sales to content to ads to your landing page and website.
sentences.zh: 你可以有最好的品牌，最好的产品，但如果没人知道你的存在，这一切都不重要。

sentences.en: It's how people find you, learn about you and pay you.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我们来说，分发涵盖了从营销、销售、内容、广告到你的着陆页和网站的一切。

sentences.en: That's what a funnel is.
sentences.zh: 这就是漏斗。

sentences.en: As an example, you found me probably through social media content.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，你大概是通过社交媒体内容找到我的。

sentences.en: You're watching this on YouTube right now, and if I can display the value of my knowledge enough, you may grow to trust me to the point of using or paying for one of my products.
sentences.zh: 你现在正在 YouTube 上看这个视频，如果我能充分展示我知识的价值，你可能会逐渐信任我，直到使用或购买我的某个产品。

sentences.en: Not because I swindled you into it, but because you see it as something useful for your own goals.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我忽悠你买，而是因为你认为它对你的目标有用。

sentences.en: It's mutual benefit value exchange.
sentences.zh: 这是互利价值交换。

sentences.en: Now, I could also run paid ads or sponsor other people's newsletters, both of which I've tried before and will probably do in the future again.
sentences.zh: 当然，我也可以投付费广告或赞助别人的 newsletter，这两样我都试过，以后大概还会再做。

sentences.en: But as a beginner with little capital, you have to look at this like stepping stones.
sentences.zh: 但作为没什么资金的初学者，你得把这些看成垫脚石。

sentences.en: You aren't going to run paid ads to an offer that isn't proven or isn't going to sell.
sentences.zh: 你不会去给一个还没验证过、卖不动的产品投付费广告。

sentences.en: You're just going to waste money.
sentences.zh: 那纯粹是浪费钱。

sentences.en: And yes, you can test through the ads, but you're testing with your own money on social media.
sentences.zh: 没错，你可以通过广告去测试，但你是拿自己的钱在测。在社交媒体上，你是免费测试。

sentences.en: You're testing your ideas, your products and services for free.
sentences.zh: 你在免费测试你的想法、你的产品和服务。

sentences.en: If you aren't growing or you aren't selling anything, then there is room for improvement.
sentences.zh: 如果你没增长，或者什么都卖不出去，那就说明还有改进空间。

sentences.en: It's trial and error.
sentences.zh: 这就是试错。

sentences.en: You just have to experiment.
sentences.zh: 你只需要去实验。

sentences.en: And if that doesn't work, experiment again.
sentences.zh: 如果不行，就再实验。

sentences.en: And if that doesn't work, learn something new and then experiment.
sentences.zh: 如果还不行，学点新东西，然后再实验。

sentences.en: And eventually you have all of these tools in your tool belt so that you become skilled at this thing called business, so that you can essentially make money at the click of a button, because you know what you're doing as you practice.
sentences.zh: 最终，你的工具箱里会装满所有这些工具，你会变得擅长商业这件事，基本上点一下按钮就能赚钱，因为你通过实践知道自己到底在做什么。

sentences.en: You're not just learning one skill.
sentences.zh: 你不只是在学一个技能。

sentences.en: You're learning human psychology, attention, mechanics, writing, content, persuasion.
sentences.zh: 你在学人类心理学、注意力机制、内容、写作、说服力。

sentences.en: All of these different things come together to make you an effective business owner.
sentences.zh: 所有这些不同的东西汇聚在一起，让你成为一个有效的企业主。

sentences.en: So we're going to talk about these AI employees or this AI team, or honestly, just skills or prompts.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要聊聊这些 AI 员工、AI 团队，或者老实说，就是技能或提示词。

sentences.en: They're all the same thing. Context for the AI.
sentences.zh: 它们都是一回事。给 AI 的上下文。

sentences.en: What these are going to do is it's going to guide you through all of this, but by doing it and actually posting it, then you get feedback against the market.
sentences.zh: 它们要做的是引导你走完整个过程，但通过你亲自去做、真正去发布，你才能从市场那里获得反馈。

sentences.en: You're not outsourcing your brain to AI just by having it do things for you, because that's not what learning is in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你不是在把大脑外包给 AI，只是让它替你做事，因为这本来就不是学习的本质。

sentences.en: You don't learn anything by watching a tutorial.
sentences.zh: 你光看教程是学不会任何东西的。

sentences.en: You learn by applying what you learn to the actual real world thing that you're trying to do.
sentences.zh: 你学习的方式，是把学到的东西应用到你想做的真实世界的事情上。

sentences.en: And then if it works, then you learned.
sentences.zh: 如果它奏效了，那你就学到了。

sentences.en: And if it didn't work, then you learned.
sentences.zh: 如果它没奏效，你也学到了。

sentences.en: But if you don't give it the chance to work or not to work, then you're not learning a thing.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不给它奏效或不奏效的机会，那你什么也学不到。

sentences.en: And even if it doesn't work the first time around, now you know that AI isn't just going to replace everything overnight.
sentences.zh: 而且就算第一次没成功，你现在也知道了，AI 不会一夜之间取代一切。

sentences.en: You understand that reality still exists, and that getting results isn't always a linear, step by step process, and that it evolves as culture changes and what is perceived as valuable changes.
sentences.zh: 你理解了现实依然存在，拿到结果并不总是一个线性的、一步步的过程，它会随着文化变迁和人们对价值的认知变化而演化。

sentences.en: So let's start to simplify this.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们开始简化这件事。

sentences.en: Here's what you're going to do to actually start this business.
sentences.zh: 下面是你真正启动这个事业要做的事。

sentences.en: So this is going to be your daily routine.
sentences.zh: 这将是你每天的日常流程。

sentences.en: The first thing you're going to do is post 1 to 3 times a day on a short form platform of your choice.
sentences.zh: 你每天要做的第一件事，就是在你选定的短内容平台上每天发 1 到 3 条。

sentences.en: This can be Substack X, LinkedIn, Instagram, etc. and you just need to pick the one that you vibe with the most.
sentences.zh: 可以是 Substack、X、LinkedIn、Instagram 等等，你只需要选一个你最有感觉的平台。

sentences.en: Now on the Eden Channel, I'm actually creating tutorials on how to grow and write content for all of these platforms.
sentences.zh: 在 Eden 频道上，我其实正在做教程，教你怎么在这些平台上增长和写内容。

sentences.en: There's already quite a few videos out so you can go and watch those, because obviously this video would be ten hours long if I did that here.
sentences.zh: 已经出了不少视频，你可以去看，因为如果我在这个视频里全讲一遍，显然会变成十个小时长。

sentences.en: But you're starting with one short form platform and you're getting really good at it.
sentences.zh: 但你一开始只做一个短内容平台，然后把它做到真正擅长。

sentences.en: I started on Twitter, but if I were starting over today, I'd probably start on Substack simply because it has long form and short form notes the growth mechanism in one place, and it's just writing so I wouldn't have to show up on video.
sentences.zh: 我是从 Twitter 起步的，但如果今天重新开始，我大概会选 Substack，原因很简单：它把长内容和短内容笔记的增长机制放在了一个地方，而且只需要写作，我不需要出镜拍视频。

sentences.en: I can sit down, I can get my coffee, and I can write ideas that I love in the morning and attempt to grow on that platform.
sentences.zh: 我可以坐下来，泡杯咖啡，在早上写下我热爱的想法，然后在这个平台上尝试增长。

sentences.en: And your followers on Substack aren't followers.
sentences.zh: 而且你在 Substack 上的粉丝不叫粉丝。

sentences.en: They're newsletter subscribers. So you own the list.
sentences.zh: 他们是 newsletter 订阅者。所以你拥有这个列表。

sentences.en: You can export it and take it somewhere else, which you can't do on any other platform.
sentences.zh: 你可以导出列表，带到别的地方去，这在其他任何平台都做不到。

sentences.en: And I'm assuming that most of you watching this have multiple interests, have deep interests.
sentences.zh: 我猜在看这个视频的人里，大多数都有多重兴趣，有深度的兴趣。

sentences.en: You like deep thought, and Substack is just the best place for that.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢深度思考，而 Substack 就是最适合这个的地方。

sentences.en: And I see a lot of beginner creators gaining traction.
sentences.zh: 我看到很多新手创作者在那里获得了增长势头。

sentences.en: Now, the second thing you're going to do is post one long form piece a week on Substack X or YouTube, but probably Substack, because that's probably where you'll start.
sentences.zh: 你要做的第二件事，是每周在 Substack、X 或 YouTube 上发一篇长内容，但大概率是 Substack，因为你大概率会从那里起步。

sentences.en: But you can do the same thing on X because they have articles now.
sentences.zh: 但你在 X 上也可以做同样的事，因为他们现在也有文章功能了。

sentences.en: So all platforms are kind of moving to this short form, long form dynamic, because that's what creators want.
sentences.zh: 所以所有平台都在往这种短内容、长内容的动态组合方向走，因为这是创作者想要的。

sentences.en: Creators understand that the more time people spend with your content, aka time under attention as I call it, like time under tension for muscle growth, it's time under attention for social media growth.
sentences.zh: 创作者明白，人们花在你内容上的时间越多——我称之为"注意力时长"，就像肌肉增长靠"受力时长"一样，社交媒体增长靠的是注意力时长。

sentences.en: People who watch a one hour long or 30 minute long YouTube video are going to have so much more trust in you than someone who watches a 15 second reel.
sentences.zh: 看了一个小时或 30 分钟 YouTube 长视频的人，对你的信任会远远超过只看了一条 15 秒 Reel 的人。

sentences.en: They would have to watch hundreds of those reels to watch the same amount of content as the 30 to 60 minute YouTube video.
sentences.zh: 后者得看几百条那样的 Reel，才能看完和一条 30 到 60 分钟 YouTube 视频同等量的内容。

sentences.en: Same thing goes for written articles like Substack or X articles.
sentences.zh: 对于书面文章也是一样，比如 Substack 或 X 上的文章。

sentences.en: So the way to make this palatable or something that you can do, is to block off 30 minutes every morning.
sentences.zh: 所以让这件事变得可行、让你能坚持下去的方法，就是每天早上划出 30 分钟。

sentences.en: So you're going to have 30 minutes for writing short form content.
sentences.zh: 你要有 30 分钟来写短内容。

sentences.en: And what that means is not staring at a blank screen.
sentences.zh: 这 30 分钟的意思不是盯着空白屏幕发呆。

sentences.en: It means researching what the AI is.
sentences.zh: 意思是做研究，搞清楚 AI 是什么。

sentences.en: I'm going to give you deciding on an idea, and then writing it out as an engaging short form post.
sentences.zh: 我来给你讲：选定一个想法，然后把它写成一条有吸引力的短内容帖子。

sentences.en: Most people struggle with the first two.
sentences.zh: 大多数人卡在前两步。

sentences.en: They don't research, they don't learn, they don't read.
sentences.zh: 他们不研究、不学习、不阅读。

sentences.en: They don't get the idea.
sentences.zh: 他们拿不到想法。

sentences.en: They don't treat that as a part of the writing process that needs to be in the same time block.
sentences.zh: 他们不把这两步当作写作过程的一部分，不把它们放进同一个时间块里。

sentences.en: And then two, they don't decide on an idea.
sentences.zh: 然后第二点，他们不选定一个想法。

sentences.en: The idea has to be perfect before they start writing on it, when the writing is how you refine the idea.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得想法必须完美才能开始写，但写作本身就是你打磨想法的过程。

sentences.en: So just pick a fucking idea and write it.
sentences.zh: 所以，就他妈选一个想法，然后写。

sentences.en: Now the second 30 minutes is for writing maybe 250 words for the long form piece.
sentences.zh: 第二个 30 分钟，是用来为长内容写大概 250 个字。

sentences.en: That can be the YouTube script, the X article, or the Substack article.
sentences.zh: 可以是 YouTube 脚本、X 文章，或者 Substack 文章。

sentences.en: What I recommend doing at the start of every week is outlining what it is you're going to write that week, you're going to pick the topic, and you're going to start brainstorming the outline and structuring it, which is what one of the A's helps you with.
sentences.zh: 我建议每周一开始就做一件事：把你这周要写的内容列个大纲，选好主题，然后开始头脑风暴，搭框架、理结构，这就是其中一个 A 能帮你做的事。

sentences.en: And now the third thing you're going to do is you're going to try to promote your offer once a day.
sentences.zh: 接下来你要做的第三件事是：每天试着推广一次你的产品。

sentences.en: So you promote it in your long form piece.
sentences.zh: 在你的长内容里推广。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the middle, you just say, hey, if you're struggling with XYZ, try this and then link your product or service and then at the end do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 在文章中间某个地方，直接说：嘿，如果你在 XYZ 上遇到困难，试试这个，然后放上你的产品或服务链接，结尾再做一次同样的事。

sentences.en: It's that simple. It's that short.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单，就这么短。

sentences.en: If you don't know how to do it, give your newsletter to AI and say, hey, I want to plug this in the middle and at the end, what's a tasteful way of promoting this?
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道怎么操作，把你的 newsletter 扔给 AI，说：嘿，我想在中间和结尾插入这个推广，怎么推比较得体？

sentences.en: And of course, since you are probably only posting long form once a week, then what you're going to do is promote once a day in another form however you can.
sentences.zh: 当然，因为你长内容大概一周只发一次，那你每天就要用其他形式、想尽办法推广一次。

sentences.en: It just has to be a part of your day.
sentences.zh: 这件事必须成为你日常的一部分。

sentences.en: You can link a reply to one of your posts on Substack or X using the simple framework to promote your product or service, which stands for Problem Amplify Solution.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Substack 或 X 上，用一条回复链接来推广你的产品或服务，就用那个简单的框架，叫 PAS：问题、放大、解决方案。

sentences.en: What's the problem if you struggle with this, this, this and this, here's the solution.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个、这个、这个和这个上面挣扎，问题是什么，解决方案在这里。

sentences.en: Link to the product.
sentences.zh: 放上产品链接。

sentences.en: Do it in your Instagram Stories.
sentences.zh: 在你的 Instagram Stories 里做。

sentences.en: Do it as a call to action on an Instagram post.
sentences.zh: 在 Instagram 帖子里做成行动号召。

sentences.en: Hey comment keyword.
sentences.zh: 比如：评论关键词。

sentences.en: If you struggle with this, this and this and want this.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个、这个和这个上挣扎，并且想要这个。

sentences.en: So that is the entire process.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个流程。

sentences.en: You build distribution by writing content. You promote your offer.
sentences.zh: 你通过写内容建立分发渠道，你推广你的产品。

sentences.en: If you haven't built an offer yet, then that's what you have to focus on as well.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没把产品做出来，那这也是你必须专注的事。

sentences.en: That's what you'll be able to build inside of Eden, by just taking the knowledge inside of your head and turning it into an AI product that doubles as a course.
sentences.zh: 这件事你可以在 Eden 里完成，只要把你脑子里的知识拿出来，把它变成一个 AI 产品，同时也是一个课程。

sentences.en: And that'll make more sense when it actually launches.
sentences.zh: 等它正式上线的时候，你会更清楚是怎么回事。

sentences.en: So keep an eye out for that, because you will make more money by simply hosting your product on Eden than any other platform, just because it's on Eden.
sentences.zh: 所以留意一下，因为光是把你的产品放在 Eden 上，你赚的钱就会比其他任何平台都多，就因为它是在 Eden 上。

sentences.en: So with this entire process, there are a few things that we can do or that we can use the AI for.
sentences.zh: 在这个完整流程里，有几件事我们可以做，或者说可以用 AI 来帮我们做。

sentences.en: The first is as a brand strategist.
sentences.zh: 第一，把它当成品牌战略师。

sentences.en: So creating a personal brand strategy so you don't blend in with everyone else and studying how your content is doing to propose growth tactics for you.
sentences.zh: 创建一套个人品牌战略，让你不会跟所有人混在一起，同时研究你内容的表现，给你提出增长策略。

sentences.en: This is like the meta layer that everything else falls under.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个元层面，其他所有东西都在它之下。

sentences.en: The second is as a content strategist which researches what's performing across social media, understands all of your prior content, pairs them with your brand strategy, and delivers a week of ideas for you to post about or have it draft content for you to edit if that's your cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 第二，把它当成内容策略师，研究全社交媒体上什么内容在火，理解你所有过往内容，把它们和你的品牌战略配对，然后给你一周的选题让你去发，或者让它起草内容你来编辑，如果你喜欢这种方式的话。

sentences.en: Now, one thing that you may not realize, if you're not like a heavy AI user is what I'm telling you here you can just copy paste.
sentences.zh: 有一件事你可能没意识到，如果你不是重度 AI 用户的话——我现在告诉你的这些东西，你可以直接复制粘贴。

sentences.en: You can just take this YouTube transcript, there's a free YouTube transcript generator at Eden, or you just paste it into Eden and you say, hey, help me implement this newsletter.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接拿这个 YouTube 视频的字幕，Eden 上有个免费的 YouTube 字幕生成器，或者你直接把它粘贴到 Eden 里，说：嘿，帮我落地这个 newsletter。

sentences.en: Help walk me through how we can actually set up a workflow to do all of these things.
sentences.zh: 帮我一步步走一遍，我们怎么真正搭建一个工作流来做所有这些事。

sentences.en: And then you converse with it back and forth until you get it right.
sentences.zh: 然后你跟它来回对话，直到把它调对。

sentences.en: And we're going to talk about how to get it right in the last section of this video, because you need to understand how to actually use AI.
sentences.zh: 我们会在这个视频最后一部分讲怎么把它调对，因为你需要理解怎么真正用好 AI。

sentences.en: Now the third thing we can use it for is as a long form specialist or outliner which understands long form frameworks and retention strategies, helping you outline a newsletter, article or video script with your ideas in a well structured way.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们可以把它当成长内容专家或大纲师，它理解长内容框架和留存策略，帮你有条理地把你的想法搭成 newsletter、文章或视频脚本的大纲。

sentences.en: Fourth, we can use it as a short form specialist, which takes your rough ideas and turns them into post drafts that you can review, edit, and schedule to go out on all platforms.
sentences.zh: 第四，我们可以把它当成短内容专家，把你粗糙的想法变成帖子草稿，你来审核、编辑，然后排期发到所有平台。

sentences.en: Fifth is an offer consultant, which helps take your experience, interest, and expertise and turns it into a compelling offer and helps you decide between what product or service to start with.
sentences.zh: 第五，把它当成产品顾问，帮你把你的经验、兴趣和专长变成一个让人无法拒绝的产品，并帮你决定先从哪个产品或服务开始。

sentences.en: And then sixth is the marketing strategist.
sentences.zh: 第六个是营销策略师。

sentences.en: So it takes your offer a brand strategy and customer avatar, then helps generate social promotions, email promotions, and landing page copy.
sentences.zh: 它会接收你的产品、品牌策略和客户画像，然后帮你生成社交媒体推广文案、邮件推广文案和落地页文案。

sentences.en: Now I've actually created all of these for you inside of here, and I'll show you what they look like really quick.
sentences.zh: 我已经在里面为你创建好了所有这些，我快速给你看一下它们长什么样。

sentences.en: But if you actually want to use them, there's the link in the description or go to Eden.
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的想用它们，链接在描述里，或者去 Eden。

sentences.en: So it's one human business and then all you do is click this button, set up my business and it will add them to your workspace.
sentences.zh: 这是一个一人企业，你只需要点这个按钮"设置我的企业"，它就会把它们添加到你的工作区。

sentences.en: Or you can download them individually as skill files for Claude or ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以把它们单独下载为 Claude 或 ChatGPT 的技能文件。

sentences.en: And for those of you who are waiting for the two hour writer update, it is being updated and we're still polishing this, but this is what it will look like.
sentences.zh: 对于那些在等两小时写作课更新的人，它正在更新中，我们还在打磨，但它会是这个样子。

sentences.en: All of the modules will be in here.
sentences.zh: 所有模块都会在这里面。

sentences.en: You'll be able to go through the curriculum and chat with it as you go, so it can help you actually implement it.
sentences.zh: 你可以一边学课程一边跟它对话，这样它能帮你真正落地执行。

sentences.en: And it has the entire course and modules as context.
sentences.zh: 而且它把整个课程和模块都作为上下文。

sentences.en: So this is what you're going to be able to sell inside of Eden as a product, not just a generic course or an AI skill.
sentences.zh: 这就是你以后能在 Eden 里作为产品销售的东西，不只是一个通用课程或 AI 技能。

sentences.en: You're going to sell the whole package and it will be branded as your own.
sentences.zh: 你会卖整个套装，而且它会以你自己的品牌呈现。

sentences.en: But these are how they're going to look inside of your workspace.
sentences.zh: 但它们在你的工作区里会是这个样子。

sentences.en: And when you add all of them, you can just switch between them here and all of your chats for each one that you create are all in here.
sentences.zh: 当你把所有模块都加进来后，你可以在这里切换它们，你为每个模块创建的所有对话都在这里。

sentences.en: So it's like your little command center for all of your little one person business AI.
sentences.zh: 就像你的小小指挥中心，管理你所有的一人企业 AI。

sentences.en: So one of my favorites is the long form outliner.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一个是长文大纲生成器。

sentences.en: So all you have to do when you want to create a nearly viral Substack article or X article or newsletter is you come into here, you click one of the starter prompts like outline a newsletter or outline a YouTube script, and then it will interview you for the idea.
sentences.zh: 当你想写一篇几乎能爆的 Substack 文章、X 文章或 newsletter 时，你只需要进来这里，点一个起始提示，比如"生成 newsletter 大纲"或"生成 YouTube 脚本大纲"，然后它会就你的想法进行提问。

sentences.en: And then it has the knowledge on how to write those things.
sentences.zh: 而且它知道怎么写这些东西。

sentences.en: And then since this is inside of Eden, or you connect Claude to the Eden MCP, it can then research everything that's going viral across Substack, XR, YouTube scripts, etc. because then it can pull the patterns and principles from the titles, the headlines, the structures of the actual articles so that it can help shape your own ideas in a way that will perform.
sentences.zh: 然后，因为这是在 Eden 里，或者你把 Claude 连接到 Eden MCP，它就能去研究 Substack、X、YouTube 脚本等平台上所有正在爆的内容，因为它能提取那些标题、开头、文章结构的模式和原则，然后用这些来帮你塑造自己的想法，让它能跑出效果。

sentences.en: And then what it does is it gives you an outline that you can then put into a board, and you can write alongside it.
sentences.zh: 然后它会给你一个大纲，你可以把它放进一个看板里，在它旁边写作。

sentences.en: Because I personally like to have AI outline things and research for me so that I have more control over the actual writing itself.
sentences.zh: 因为我个人喜欢让 AI 来生成大纲和做研究，这样我对实际写作本身有更多掌控。

sentences.en: So then I have my little writing workspace in here too.
sentences.zh: 所以我在这里也有我的小写作工作区。

sentences.en: And then when it's time to publish to Substack or any social media platform, I just go to the publish tab and I can do it all from here.
sentences.zh: 然后到了要发布到 Substack 或任何社交媒体平台的时候，我只需要去发布标签页，就能在这里完成所有操作。

sentences.en: So I spent a lot of time on these.
sentences.zh: 我在这些上面花了很多时间。

sentences.en: These are free to use.
sentences.zh: 这些都是免费用的。

sentences.en: Of course, you're going to have to pay for Claude or ChatGPT or Eden if you want a decent amount of AI usage to actually run through it.
sentences.zh: 当然，你得为 Claude 或 ChatGPT 或 Eden 付费，如果你想有足够的 AI 使用额度来真正跑通它的话。

sentences.en: But that's just how these things go.
sentences.zh: 但事情就是这样。

sentences.en: The actual context, the knowledge inside of these eyes is free for you to use, and it's structured around things that work.
sentences.zh: 这些 AI 里面的实际上下文、知识是免费给你用的，而且它们是围绕有效的方法构建的。

sentences.en: Because if you just ask AI like a general Claude chat for these things, it's going to have no idea what to do, and it's going to give you horrible information you need to shape and mold the context around what works.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你只是随便问一个通用 Claude 对话来做这些事，它根本不知道该怎么做，会给你一堆垃圾信息。你需要围绕有效的方法来塑造和打磨上下文。

sentences.en: So I'd recommend going through these in the order I listed above.
sentences.zh: 所以我建议按我上面列的顺序来用它们。

sentences.en: So brand strategy first, then content strategy, and then you base your short form and long form posts off of those.
sentences.zh: 先做品牌策略，然后是内容策略，然后你的短内容和长内容都基于这些来写。

sentences.en: And once you have an offer, then you can use the Marketing Strategist one.
sentences.zh: 一旦你有了产品，就可以用营销策略师。

sentences.en: And then once you refine this process enough, you can start to run these on routines.
sentences.zh: 然后当你把这个流程打磨得足够好之后，你可以开始用例行任务来跑它们。

sentences.en: So in the content strategist you can just say, hey, do this every Monday for me and put it inside of a table so that all of the ideas are there and I can take them and run with them.
sentences.zh: 比如在内容策略师里，你可以直接说，嘿，每周一帮我做这个，放进一个表格里，这样所有想法都在里面，我拿起来就能用。

sentences.en: And now you'll notice that none of these, at least the ones that I created, have it do the writing for you.
sentences.zh: 现在你会注意到，这些提示词——至少我自己做的那些——没有一个让它替你写作。

sentences.en: It doesn't actually create the content for you, because I don't think that's wise to do as a beginner.
sentences.zh: 它不会真的替你生成内容，因为我觉得对新手来说，这么做不明智。

sentences.en: And I personally don't think we're at the point where we should automate that side of things.
sentences.zh: 而且我个人认为，我们还没到应该把写作这件事完全自动化的阶段。

sentences.en: Yet, even though I'm kind of changing my opinion on writing with AI, because ultimately you choose which will kind of go over in a sack.
sentences.zh: 至少现在还没到，尽管我对用 AI 写作的看法正在改变，因为最终选择权在你手里。

sentences.en: But if you want the AI to do those things for you to write for you, then I'm not entirely opposed to it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想让 AI 替你写、替你完成这些事，我倒也不是完全反对。

sentences.en: But you have to understand what we're going to discuss in a second.
sentences.zh: 只不过你得先理解我们接下来要讨论的东西。

sentences.en: So now I want to go over the best way to use AI in general when doing any of this, because there's so much information on social media you're getting, you're just drowning in the Instagram Reels, telling you to download a specific skill, like a cloud skill that you plug in, and then it does things for you, which is great.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我想讲讲，在做这些事情时，使用 AI 的最佳方式到底是什么。因为社交媒体上的信息太多了，你被 Instagram Reels 淹没，都在告诉你去下载某个技能，比如一个插件，装上就能替你干活，这确实挺好。

sentences.en: But if you don't know how to actually think about using AI or go about using it, then you're going to run the skill just like you downloaded a notion template, and then it's going to give you something.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不知道如何真正思考 AI 的使用方式，不知道怎么去用它，那你运行那个技能，就像你下载了一个 Notion 模板，然后它会给你产出点东西。

sentences.en: You're going to be like, oh, that's cool, and then you're going to leave it or it's going to give you something that sucks and you're going to be like, oh, this doesn't work, or AI just sucks, or AI bad, or AI just makes things up and hallucinate.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得"哦，挺酷的"，然后就把它扔一边了；或者它给你一个垃圾结果，你就会说"哦，这玩意儿没用"，或者"AI 就是垃圾"，"AI 不行"，"AI 只会瞎编和产生幻觉"。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to trust it, even though that's not how it works.
sentences.zh: 于是你就决定不再信任它，尽管事实根本不是这样运作的。

sentences.en: People are just as stupid and hallucinate just as much.
sentences.zh: 人一样蠢，也一样经常产生幻觉。

sentences.en: And if you go on social media, 99% of the people are giving you misinformation.
sentences.zh: 你上社交媒体看看，99% 的人都在给你错误信息。

sentences.en: There has never not been a time where you don't have to think critically for yourself.
sentences.zh: 从来没有哪个时代，你不需要自己批判性地思考。

sentences.en: And just because you use AI doesn't mean that just goes out the window.
sentences.zh: 不会因为你用了 AI，这一点就突然失效了。

sentences.en: Now, this section is going to lose quite a few people because it's a difficult process to understand, and it doesn't make sense until you actually do it.
sentences.zh: 接下来这一部分可能会让很多人掉队，因为它是一个很难理解的过程，只有你真的去做了，它才会变得合理。

sentences.en: And it takes a certain level of systems thinking to understand it and implement it.
sentences.zh: 而且需要一定程度的系统思维，才能理解并执行它。

sentences.en: But if you watch through this and you try to understand it, then when you go about using AI the next time around, you'll start to notice it and implement new things.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把这一部分看完，试着去理解，那么下次你再用 AI 的时候，你就会开始注意到这些，并引入新的做法。

sentences.en: Now, the problem with AI is that people think of it as some kind of just all powerful being.
sentences.zh: AI 的问题在于，人们把它当成某种全知全能的存在。

sentences.en: And since it's not an all powerful being, even though we essentially have AGI at this point, and many GPT six, Astra and Fable 5.1 still aren't able to do things very well without proper context.
sentences.zh: 而因为它并不是全知全能的存在——尽管我们现阶段基本上已经有了 AGI，但很多 GPT-6、Astra 和 Fable 5.1 在没有足够上下文的情况下，依然做不好事情。

sentences.en: But since it's not an all powerful being when it doesn't do exactly what they want, what the person wants because they don't know what they want, they just assume it's only capable of generating slop.
sentences.zh: 但正因为它不是全知全能的存在，当它没有完全做到那个人想要的东西时——而那个人自己都不知道自己想要什么——他们就直接认定 AI 只能产出垃圾。

sentences.en: And now a great example of this.
sentences.zh: 举一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: I saw a real the other day where some guy was just saying, hey, don't use ChatGPT to build your website if you're a small business owner, because we can tell that it's AI.
sentences.zh: 我前几天看到一个 Reel，有个家伙说，嘿，如果你是小企业主，别用 ChatGPT 来建网站，因为我们一眼就能看出那是 AI 做的。

sentences.en: And now if you actually use AI, you find this laughable.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的用过 AI，你会觉得这话很可笑。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: If you just tell AI, hey, build a website for this, this and this, then it's going to look like every other AI generated website.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是告诉 AI，"嘿，帮我建一个网站，要这个、这个和这个"，那它确实会看起来跟所有其他 AI 生成的网站一模一样。

sentences.en: But if you give it examples and clear instructions, then at least you're off to a better start.
sentences.zh: 但如果你给它示例和清晰的指令，至少你的起点会好得多。

sentences.en: But that's not the full picture.
sentences.zh: 但这还不是全貌。

sentences.en: After that, you actually have to start digging into the details.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，你必须真正开始深入细节。

sentences.en: You have to tweak the border radius and the color and the drop shadow and the layouts and how you want things to be at that point, when you have the prototype or the template or the first draft, then you do what any other designer would do in Photoshop or Figma.
sentences.zh: 你得去调整圆角半径、颜色、投影、布局，以及你希望东西呈现的样子。到了那个节点，当你有了原型、模板或初稿之后，你要做的，就是任何一个设计师在 Photoshop 或 Figma 里会做的事。

sentences.en: You go through, and you make all of the tiny detail adjustments so that it becomes unique.
sentences.zh: 你逐一过一遍，做出所有微小的细节调整，让它变得独一无二。

sentences.en: It becomes premium.
sentences.zh: 让它变得有高级感。

sentences.en: AI can, in fact make minor changes.
sentences.zh: AI 其实完全可以做微小的改动。

sentences.en: You don't have to try to one shot everything or when you're editing a video, yeah, you can have it go through and you can have it cut everything and put animations everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你不需要试图一次性搞定所有东西。或者当你在剪辑视频时，没错，你可以让它自动过一遍，自动切好所有片段、加上各种动画。

sentences.en: But that's the broad sweep.
sentences.zh: 但那只是粗扫一遍。

sentences.en: And then when you go through you're like, oh, this sucks.
sentences.zh: 然后你走完一遍流程，一看，妈的，这什么东西。

sentences.en: And then you stop using it.
sentences.zh: 接着你就不用了。

sentences.en: When you just go in and you say, hey, make this a little better, do this, do this, do this.
sentences.zh: 但如果你进去，跟它说：嘿，把这里改好一点，做这个，做那个，再改这个。

sentences.en: That's when the actual editing comes into play.
sentences.zh: 真正的编辑工作这才开始。

sentences.en: It's probably not going to one shot something exactly how you wanted it, because you didn't tell it what you wanted.
sentences.zh: 你不可能一次就得到完全符合你预期的结果，因为你根本没告诉它你到底想要什么。

sentences.en: And that's okay, because you're probably not going to write a 1000 word paragraph to the AI.
sentences.zh: 这也没关系，因为你大概率不会给 AI 写一段 1000 字的提示词。

sentences.en: You're going to have it do a broad sweep and it's like, okay, this is okay.
sentences.zh: 你会让它先扫一遍大框架，然后你觉得，嗯，还行。

sentences.en: And then you go through and you do the minor details.
sentences.zh: 接着你再自己过一遍，处理那些微小的细节。

sentences.en: So telling AI to create a website or write a newsletter or write a tweet today is exactly like just downloading a WordPress template.
sentences.zh: 所以今天你让 AI 建个网站、写篇 newsletter 或者写条推文，本质上就跟当年下载一个 WordPress 模板一模一样。

sentences.en: In the past, people can tell because it's not a good effort, and there was just as much slop a few years ago as there is today.
sentences.zh: 过去人们一眼就能看出来，因为那东西没用心，而且几年前的垃圾内容跟今天一样多。

sentences.en: But AI is just some special case that people really dislike.
sentences.zh: 只不过 AI 成了一个特殊靶子，大家特别讨厌它。

sentences.en: So you can stop there and have a pretty terrible website that doesn't make your brand unique in the slightest.
sentences.zh: 你可以到此为止，得到一个烂网站，让你的品牌毫无独特性可言。

sentences.en: Or you can use that as a starting point to iterate from, just like you can build an app, but then you have to resolve issues in bugfixes until it's actually a good app.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以把它当作一个起点，不断迭代——就像你开发一个 App，之后还得不断解决问题、修 bug，直到它真正变成一个好产品。

sentences.en: Now, the baseline for what is considered this modern WordPress template, or slop, will continue to rise, forcing people to develop more tasting experience if they actually want to stand out.
sentences.zh: 现在，所谓的"现代 WordPress 模板"或者说垃圾内容的基准线会不断抬高，逼着人们去积累更多品味和经验，如果他们真的想脱颖而出的话。

sentences.en: And this is part of why my opinion around writing with AI is changing.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么我对用 AI 写作的看法正在改变。

sentences.en: Because if you treated it like you did, when you actually sit down to write, you'd realize that you'd have more control, more creativity, more opportunity if you used AI.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你像真正坐下来写作时那样对待它，你就会意识到，用 AI 其实能让你拥有更多控制权、更多创造力、更多机会。

sentences.en: But what people do is they say, hey, write this newsletter for me.
sentences.zh: 但人们怎么做呢？他们说：嘿，帮我写篇 newsletter。

sentences.en: And when it's not good, they just consider it slop or they think it's okay and they make the choice to post it because they don't have taste or experience.
sentences.zh: 写得不好，他们要么直接归为垃圾，要么觉得还行就选择发出去——因为他们没有品味，也没有经验。

sentences.en: And I think taste is what you're not willing to put out into the world.
sentences.zh: 我觉得品味就是，你不愿意把什么东西放到这个世界上。

sentences.en: And so when they post it, people immediately tell it's AI.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一发出来，别人立刻就能看出是 AI 写的。

sentences.en: But for people who actually treat writing as a craft with AI, nobody can tell because it's not the baseline WordPress template, and it's something that you choose to post because it represents what you would have said.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些真正把写作当成一门手艺、同时善用 AI 的人来说，没人能看出来，因为那已经不是基准线的 WordPress 模板了，那是你选择发出去的东西，因为它代表了你本来就会说的话。

sentences.en: It represents your values, your worldview, your opinion.
sentences.zh: 它代表你的价值观、你的世界观、你的观点。

sentences.en: And it's not like writers are super authentic anyways, talking in the voice they talk to when they're talking to a friend.
sentences.zh: 再说了，写作者也没那么真实，他们写东西时用的语气，跟他们和朋友聊天时完全不一样。

sentences.en: No, they've created their writing voice and they're faking it.
sentences.zh: 不，他们创造了自己的写作声音，他们在装。

sentences.en: They have a mask on and that's okay.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着一副面具，这没什么问题。

sentences.en: That's what part of being human is.
sentences.zh: 这就是做人的一部分。

sentences.en: So with that out of the way, what do we actually do?
sentences.zh: 好了，把这些说清楚之后，我们到底该怎么做？

sentences.en: How can we create something like the weekly content strategist that I showed you?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么才能做出像我给你们展示的那个 weekly content strategist 一样的东西？

sentences.en: That's actually good.
sentences.zh: 一个真正好的东西。

sentences.en: The first thing is that you need to know what good looks like, or have an example of what good looks like, because when it comes to good content or good posting on social media, there's a lot at play.
sentences.zh: 第一件事，你得知道"好"是什么样子的，或者有一个"好"的范本，因为说到好内容、好的社交媒体发布，这里面涉及的因素太多了。

sentences.en: There's the structure of the post, article or newsletter.
sentences.zh: 包括帖子、文章或 newsletter 的结构。

sentences.en: There's the creator's vibe or energy signature, there's the through line of their brand and big ideas they incorporate consistently to get their worldview across.
sentences.zh: 包括创作者的气场或者说能量印记，包括贯穿他们品牌的叙事主线，以及他们持续融入的那些大想法，用来传递自己的世界观。

sentences.en: And there's the unique ideas they stumble across that help them stand out from everyone else.
sentences.zh: 还包括他们偶然发现的独特想法，这些想法让他们从所有人中脱颖而出。

sentences.en: So all of this needs to be accounted for.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切都需要被考虑进去。

sentences.en: No AI is going to tell you that no AI is going to do that by default.
sentences.zh: 没有 AI 会主动告诉你这些，也没有 AI 会默认帮你做这些。

sentences.en: You can only find it through mentorship or experience, or learning from someone who has that specific knowledge, because there is no one way to create content.
sentences.zh: 你只能通过导师指导、亲身经验，或者向拥有特定知识的人学习来获得，因为创作内容没有唯一的方法。

sentences.en: But now that you know these things, you need a reference or an example or instructions that you can give the AI to constrain the context, that means giving it YouTube titles and transcripts of videos that represent the type of content you want to create.
sentences.zh: 但既然你现在知道了这些，你就需要一个参考、一个范例或一套指令，用来约束 AI 的上下文。这意味着给它 YouTube 标题和视频字幕，代表你想创作的内容类型。

sentences.en: It means reels, transcripts, Substack notes or articles, X posts or articles, or ample examples of the style of writing that you like.
sentences.zh: 也意味着给它 Reels 字幕、Substack 笔记或文章、X 帖子或文章，或者大量你喜欢的写作风格的范例。

sentences.en: That's how I start out most AI chats these days.
sentences.zh: 这就是我最近开启大多数 AI 对话的方式。

sentences.en: If I know what I want, then I just give detailed instructions.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道自己想要什么，我就直接给出详细指令。

sentences.en: In the past, I've written 2000 word prompts, teaching it to write tweets like I do, and it gets extremely close.
sentences.zh: 过去我写过 2000 字的提示词，教它像我一样写推文，它能模仿得非常接近。

sentences.en: But you wouldn't be able to do that just by asking it to look at my best tweets, because it will try to templates those and doesn't account for the thinking process that went into writing them.
sentences.zh: 但如果你只是让它去看我最好的推文，你是做不到这一点的，因为它会试图模板化那些推文，而不会考虑写出它们背后的思考过程。

sentences.en: And now, more importantly, if I don't know what I want, then I start researching and I ask questions until I have clarity and fill the context window with the right information.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，如果我不知道自己想要什么，我就会开始研究、不断提问，直到我思路清晰，用正确的信息填满上下文窗口。

sentences.en: So if I'm designing something, then I need a reference.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我在设计什么东西，我就需要一个参考。

sentences.en: I need to go look on Maybin or another inspiration site.
sentences.zh: 我需要去 Maybin 或其他灵感网站看看。

sentences.en: If I'm writing content, then I have to go to Eden, the discover tab and find high performing ideas.
sentences.zh: 如果我在写内容，我就得去 Eden 的发现页，找到高表现力的创意。

sentences.en: What that means is I don't just say, hey, write me a newsletter on this topic.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我不会直接说“嘿，帮我写一篇关于这个主题的 newsletter”。

sentences.en: I ask questions to decide which newsletter to write about.
sentences.zh: 我会通过提问来决定写哪一篇 newsletter。

sentences.en: So in your case, you could ask something like, I want to write one of the greatest, most engaging newsletters in the world, something that stands out and doesn't sound robotic.
sentences.zh: 所以在你这种情况下，你可以这样问：我想写出世界上最出色、最有吸引力的 newsletter 之一，那种能脱颖而出、听起来不像机器人的。

sentences.en: Let's treat this as a brainstorming session until we land on a style that I like.
sentences.zh: 我们把这次对话当作头脑风暴，直到我们找到我喜欢的风格。

sentences.en: Start by asking clarifying questions on what you need for me to make this happen.
sentences.zh: 先问我一些澄清性的问题，搞清楚你需要什么才能让我实现这个目标。

sentences.en: We'll go from there.
sentences.zh: 然后我们从那里开始。

sentences.en: And then at the end of this conversation and after giving it different examples, ask it to condense it into a document or a skill that you'll be able to transfer between different chats.
sentences.zh: 在这场对话的最后，在给了它各种范例之后，让它把所有内容浓缩成一份文档或一项技能，让你能在不同的对话之间迁移使用。

sentences.en: Now the second thing is that you need to understand the process that gets results, or start with someone else's process until you develop your own.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是，你需要理解那个能产生结果的过程，或者从别人的过程开始，直到你发展出自己的过程。

sentences.en: So for something like a content strategist, this isn't as simple as just telling the AI to research top performing post, because that's not the only thing that a content strategist does.
sentences.zh: 就拿内容策略师来说，这并不像告诉 AI “去研究表现最好的帖子”那么简单，因为那不是内容策略师做的唯一一件事。

sentences.en: And if you don't know that, then you're not going to be able to implement that in your business.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道这一点，你就无法在你的业务中落实它。

sentences.en: Asking it to research top ideas is what a below average person would do.
sentences.zh: 让它去研究热门创意，是低于平均水平的人会做的事。

sentences.en: So if you ask Claude to do that, even though it's genius level AGI intelligence simply because you asked it to do something, that is what below average people do, then the results you get are going to be below average because it's not going to tell you.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你让 Claude 去做这件事，即使它拥有天才级别的 AGI 智能，仅仅因为你让它做的是低于平均水平的人做的事，你得到的结果也会是低于平均水平的，因为它不会告诉你：

sentences.en: Hey, do this instead.
sentences.zh: “嘿，不如试试这样做。”

sentences.en: And the below below average person would just ask the AI to write a viral post for them.
sentences.zh: 而那个低于平均水平的人，只会直接让 AI 帮他们写一篇爆款帖子。

sentences.en: So when I think about my own content writing process, it goes like this.
sentences.zh: 所以当我思考自己的内容写作过程时，它是这样的。

sentences.en: And this is what I would try to distill into a workflow with AI.
sentences.zh: 这也是我会尝试提炼成 AI 工作流的东西。

sentences.en: First is I read books, save ideas, have conversations with friends, listened along, lectures for ideas that nobody is talking about online.
sentences.zh: 第一，我读书、保存想法、和朋友聊天、听长篇讲座，寻找那些网上没人谈论的创意。

sentences.en: Then I pick an idea at the intersection of one what I am excited to write about, to what people will massively benefit from, and three what is already validated and performing well.
sentences.zh: 第二，我挑选一个处于三个条件交汇点的创意：一是我有激情去写的，二是人们会从中获得巨大收益的，三是已经被验证且表现良好的。

sentences.en: The third thing is I brain dump title ideas for the article or script, and then I find the best ideas that would fit into that piece.
sentences.zh: 第三，我为文章或脚本进行标题创意的脑暴，然后找出最适合放进那篇内容的最佳想法。

sentences.en: Fourth, I consider which long form structure would be the best to house those ideas and start outlining it.
sentences.zh: 第四，我考虑哪种长内容结构最适合容纳这些想法，然后开始列大纲。

sentences.en: And then fifth, from that outline, I brainstorm 10 to 20 short form content ideas that I can take and run with.
sentences.zh: 第五，基于那个大纲，我脑暴 10 到 20 个短内容创意，可以直接拿来用。

sentences.en: And this is also considering that I already have the branding side of things down, which is an entirely different process and story, because that's what would allow the content strategist to understand my worldview, my influences, my mission, and my brand enemy.
sentences.zh: 这还考虑到我已经搞定了品牌建设方面的事，那是一个完全不同的过程和故事，因为正是品牌能让内容策略师理解我的世界观、我的影响来源、我的使命和我的品牌敌人。

sentences.en: So the difficult part is turning all of those into a process that the AI can help with, because it obviously can't read books or discover ideas.
sentences.zh: 所以最难的部分，是把所有这些变成一套 AI 能帮上忙的流程，因为它显然没法自己去读书或发现想法。

sentences.en: For me, that's the edge. Then that can't be outsourced.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这才是优势所在。这部分没法外包。

sentences.en: That's what makes your process a bit more irreplaceable than the next person's. But I can capture all of my ideas into my Eden Library, which auto tags and connects ideas so the AI can pull from them as a bank of ideas each week to give me a few options that are likely to do well, meaning I can focus more on reading and learning rather than treating it as something to outsource because I enjoy that process.
sentences.zh: 这就是让你的流程比别人的更不可替代的原因。但我可以把我所有的想法捕捉进我的 Eden Library，它会自动打标签、连接想法，这样 AI 每周就能从中提取一个想法库，给我几个可能效果不错的选项，意味着我可以把更多精力放在阅读和学习上，而不是把它当成可以外包的东西——因为我享受这个过程。

sentences.en: Then the main thing I need to do is instruct the AI on how to perform good research.
sentences.zh: 然后我需要做的主要事情，就是指导 AI 怎么做好的研究。

sentences.en: What ideas are worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 哪些想法值得做。

sentences.en: So as an example, celebrity posts that went viral aren't a signal as to what's performing on social media.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，名人爆火的帖子并不能代表社交媒体上什么内容在流行。

sentences.en: Small to mid-size accounts.
sentences.zh: 要看中小型账号。

sentences.en: Outlier posts are then how to match the right topics to my own novel ideas and examples of my own content structures that have worked in the past.
sentences.zh: 看那些异常值帖子，然后把正确的选题匹配到我自己的新颖想法上，匹配到我自己过去验证过的内容结构上。

sentences.en: Then you have it.
sentences.zh: 然后你就让它。

sentences.en: Spit all of that out into a table that it can update and reference every single week.
sentences.zh: 把所有这些吐到一个表格里，每周更新、每周参考。

sentences.en: Now, the third thing you need is to continuously improve and iterate the system you build, as you've always needed to do.
sentences.zh: 好，第三件你需要做的事，是持续改进和迭代你构建的系统，这一直都是你必须做的。

sentences.en: This is more life advice or reality advice than it is AI advice.
sentences.zh: 这更像是人生建议或者现实建议，而不是 AI 建议。

sentences.en: But we are building a system here.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里就是在构建一个系统。

sentences.en: Life is systems. Your mind is a set of nested systems.
sentences.zh: 人生就是系统。你的心智是一套嵌套的系统。

sentences.en: The road is a system.
sentences.zh: 道路是一个系统。

sentences.en: Everything is a system. So we're building a system.
sentences.zh: 一切都是系统。所以我们在构建一个系统。

sentences.en: And if you've ever used a notion template or had any form of morning routine, you understand that sometimes a system isn't always reliable or you outgrow it, or something throws a wrench in it, and it just doesn't work out for that specific situation.
sentences.zh: 如果你用过任何 notion 模板，或者有过任何形式的晨间惯例，你就明白有时候一个系统并不总是可靠的，或者你成长到超越了它，或者有什么东西突然卡住了它，在那个特定情况下它就是行不通。

sentences.en: But that isn't a reason to think that the system doesn't work altogether, and it doesn't mean that you abandon it entirely.
sentences.zh: 但这不代表整个系统都没用，也不意味着你要彻底抛弃它。

sentences.en: It means you iterate and make it adaptable.
sentences.zh: 它意味着你要迭代，让它变得可适应。

sentences.en: So with AI, what this means is that whenever you notice something wrong or off or that looks like slop, then you tell it what's wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以放在 AI 上，意思就是每当你注意到有什么不对劲、有什么偏差、或者看起来像垃圾输出，你就告诉它哪里有问题。

sentences.en: You improve the system, you give suggestions, you ask more questions, you start to move in a different direction until you get to where you actually want to go.
sentences.zh: 你改进系统，你给建议，你问更多问题，你开始朝不同的方向移动，直到你真正到达你想去的地方。

sentences.en: Personally, I think most people are just afraid of the uncertainty that comes with AI.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我觉得大多数人只是害怕 AI 带来的不确定性。

sentences.en: It's very similar to entrepreneurship.
sentences.zh: 这和创业非常像。

sentences.en: It's directly engaging with the process of trial and error, simply because they don't get the certain cheap dopamine result that you get everywhere else.
sentences.zh: 它直接让你面对试错的过程，仅仅因为他们没法从中得到那种确定的、廉价的、在其他地方都能得到的多巴胺结果。

sentences.en: They label it as bad or it doesn't work, or oh, you're just outsourcing your thinking when it's the complete opposite.
sentences.zh: 他们就把它贴上"不好"或者"没用"的标签，或者"哦，你只是在外包你的思考"，而事实恰恰相反。

sentences.en: And they're just repeating that because it's a line that was programed into their head.
sentences.zh: 他们只是重复那句话，因为那是被编程进他们脑子里的台词。

sentences.en: So who's the more machine like person here?
sentences.zh: 所以，谁才是更像机器的那个人？

sentences.en: Like everything we just talked about just doesn't click for them.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才聊的所有东西，对他们来说就是无法理解。

sentences.en: And that's fine because people like this, people where none of this clicked for you, you need to actually step into the arena and stop trying to outsource things before you even know what to outsource.
sentences.zh: 这也没关系，因为像这样的人——那些刚才所有内容你都没理解的人——你需要真正踏入竞技场，而不是在你甚至都不知道该外包什么之前，就试图外包一切。

sentences.en: You can't outsource content until you've you're actually doing content.
sentences.zh: 在你真正开始做内容之前，你没法外包内容。

sentences.en: You can't outsource something that doesn't exist.
sentences.zh: 你没法外包一个根本不存在的东西。

sentences.en: You can't automate it.
sentences.zh: 你没法自动化它。

sentences.en: Most people are trying to automate things by downloading the skills before they even have anything worth automating.
sentences.zh: 大多数人试图通过下载技能来自动化事情，可他们连任何值得自动化的东西都还没有。

sentences.en: You don't even have anything that works yet.
sentences.zh: 你连一个真正跑通的东西都还没有。

sentences.en: But for those who did understand this, you understand how revolutionary it is.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些真正理解这一点的人来说，你知道这有多革命性。

sentences.en: So I hope this was helpful.
sentences.zh: 希望这期内容对你有帮助。

sentences.en: I help the customize with the link in the description serve you well, and if you want to build your own custom AI or tack a course onto it and sell it in Eden, then that will be available very soon.
sentences.zh: 描述里的链接能帮你定制自己的东西，如果你还想搭建自己的定制 AI，或者在上面挂一门课然后在 Eden 上卖，这个功能很快就能用了。

sentences.en: And I am super stoked about that. So we'll talk soon.
sentences.zh: 我对此超级兴奋。我们很快再聊。

sentences.en: Like subscribe while you here is just a click of a button and I'll see you in the next video. Bye!
sentences.zh: 既然都在这儿了，点个赞、订阅一下，就一个按钮的事。下期视频见。拜拜！
